name: Jet Solar Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2001, Jet Solar Limited is in the solar business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
JSL focuses on residential projects in Maharashtra and Gujarat. Its operations cover all aspects of real estate development, from the identification and acquisition of land, planning, execution, and marketing of its projects, maintenance and management of its completed developments, etc. Company’s ongoing projects are at Hill Station in Dharampur, Valsad known 
as Wilson Hills.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.18% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.70% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 351 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -54.8%
